components.label: Load Balancer
components.note: Terminates inbound HTTPS, routes each request by platform, skips unhealthy instances and keeps returning users on the same server.

components.label: Mobile Pool
components.note: Backend pool tuned for mobile API traffic.

components.label: Web Pool
components.note: Backend pool that renders full web pages for desktop.

cards.title: Platform-specific routing
items: Mobile and desktop requests go to specialized pools, so each device gets a tailored response.

cards.title: SSL termination
items: The load balancer decrypts HTTPS once, offloading TLS work from backend instances.
